changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO catalog_items (code, name, short_description, item_type, capacity_unit, is_core, min_quantity, max_quantity, sort_order, status, trial_eligibility, default_trial_days, trial_outcome, service_nature) SELECT seed.code, seed.name, seed.short_description, 'CAPACITY', seed.capacity_unit, TRUE, 1, NULL, seed.sort_order, 'ACTIVE', 'NEVER_FREE', NULL, NULL, 'SOFTWARE_LICENSING' FROM ( SELECT 'CAPACITY_BRANCH' AS code, 'Sede incluida' AS name, 'Una sede de trabajo (laboratorio)' AS short_description, 'BRANCH' AS capacity_unit, 11 AS sort_order UNION ALL SELECT 'CAPACITY_USER', 'Usuario incluido', 'Un usuario de acceso (laboratorio)', 'USER', 12 ) seed WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog_items x WHERE x.code = seed.code);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM catalog_items WHERE code IN ('CAPACITY_BRANCH','CAPACITY_USER');

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO catalog_prices (price_list_id, catalog_item_id, billing_cycle, tier_min, tier_max, included_quantity, unit_amount, setup_amount, tax_rate, tax_treatment) SELECT pl.id, ci.id, 'MONTHLY', 1, NULL, 0, seed.unit_amount, 0.00, 19.00, 'TAXED' FROM price_lists pl JOIN ( SELECT 'CAPACITY_BRANCH' AS code, 25000.00 AS unit_amount UNION ALL SELECT 'CAPACITY_USER', 15000.00 ) seed ON 1 = 1 JOIN catalog_items ci ON ci.code = seed.code WHERE pl.code = 'LISTA-LOCAL-LAB' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM catalog_prices x WHERE x.price_list_id = pl.id AND x.catalog_item_id = ci.id AND x.billing_cycle = 'MONTHLY' AND x.tier_min = 1);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM catalog_prices WHERE price_list_id IN (SELECT id FROM price_lists WHERE code = 'LISTA-LOCAL-LAB') AND catalog_item_id IN ( SELECT id FROM catalog_items WHERE code IN ('CAPACITY_BRANCH','CAPACITY_USER'));
